project_type: Monorepo: Python FastAPI service (project-ai) + TypeScript/Node repository discovery + Playwright browser tests
language: Python 3.11+ for agents/orchestration, TypeScript for repository discovery, Node/Playwright for browser tests
build_system: pnpm workspaces for TypeScript/Node, setuptools for Python service, no global build command
test_framework: pytest 9.1.1 with pytest-asyncio for Python unit tests, Playwright for browser E2E tests
build_command: No global build. Python: cd services/project-ai && python -m pytest. TypeScript discovery: pnpm tsx .agents/scripts/regenerate-m1-snapshot.mjs. Playwright: pnpm exec playwright test --config=playwright.project-ai.config.ts
test_command: cd services/project-ai && python -m pytest (runs all 330+ tests). For specific modules: python -m pytest tests/agents/test_{agent_name}.py
verification_instructions: After each wave: (1) Run python -m pytest for changed modules, (2) Verify imports with python -c 'from app.models.{module} import *', (3) For orchestration changes run full test suite, (4) For Playwright integration run pnpm exec playwright test --config=playwright.project-ai.config.ts
snapshot_or_generated_files: TypeScript generates .agents/output/snapshot.json (via pnpm tsx .agents/scripts/regenerate-m1-snapshot.mjs). Evidence logger creates .project-ai/runs/{commit-sha}-{snapshot-hash}/ directory structure. Playwright generates .project-ai/runs/current/results/playwright.json. All are artifacts, not checked into git.
environment_constraints: Windows platform (win32, PowerShell). Python async agents use asyncio. Playwright MUST run sequentially (workers: 1) per playwright.project-ai.config.ts. TypeScript discovery called via subprocess pnpm tsx. NO Python Playwright library - orchestrate Node Playwright via pnpm exec. Repository root: e:\onlinewebsites\quiz-platform. Python service root: services/project-ai.
contribution_requirements: Design document approved (project-ai-dag-design.md v1.2). Implementation must follow 15-agent DAG architecture. Key invariants: (1) TypeScript generates all repository facts, Python never scans files directly, (2) Snapshot generated once at Agent 02, frozen forever, (3) Placement executor consumes ONLY approved manifest, never recomputes placement, (4) Every PASS requires evidence_ids + commit_sha + snapshot_hash, (5) Brand/Theme gates consume snapshot data, NO Path.read_text() scanning, (6) Final gate requires ALL 14 gates passing (CONTRACT, ILS, LSNB, RSSB, UBRC, REGISTRY, RENDERER, COMPOSER, TESTS, RUNTIME, BROWSER, BRAND_INDEPENDENCE, THEME_COMPATIBILITY, EVIDENCE). NOTE: Design doc says 15-agent but ILS/LSNB/RSSB deferred to Phase 2, so 12 gates in MVP.
key_patterns: Agent pattern: async def execute_{agent_name}(context: AgentContext) -> AgentResult. All agents in services/project-ai/app/agents/ with matching test files in tests/agents/test_{agent_name}.py. Models use Pydantic BaseModel or dataclasses. Evidence binding: every result includes evidence_ids list from TypeScript snapshot. Gate pattern: methods in CertificationGateExecutor class in app/certification/gates.py returning GateExecutionResult. Orchestration: AgentCoordinator.execute_dag() with dependency resolution. TypeScript subprocess calls: subprocess.run(['pnpm', 'tsx', script_path], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=repo_root, timeout=300).
directory_structure: services/project-ai/app/ contains: agents/ (15 agent implementations), certification/ (gates.py with gate methods), models/ (Pydantic models), orchestration/ (agent_coordinator.py, agent_registry.py, workflow_engine.py, workflow_dag.py), placement/ (executor.py, comparator.py), evidence/ (logger.py, graph.py, query.py), verification/ (brand.py, theme.py, composer.py, runtime.py, browser.py), repository/ (discovery_client.py), api/ (FastAPI routes). tests/ mirrors app/ structure. .project-ai/runs/ for evidence artifacts. playwright.project-ai.config.ts in repo root for browser tests.
